paragraphs.text: 1. THESE first, the boundless Sea, and Matarisvan, fierce-glowing Fire, the Strong, the Bliss-bestower,
And heavenly Floods, first-born by holy Order, exclaimed against the outrage on a Brahman.
paragraphs.original: वीळुहरास्तप उग्रो मयोभूरापो देवीः प्रथमजा ऋतेन
paragraphs.translit: vīḷuharāstapa ugro mayobhūrāpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtena

paragraphs.text: 2. King Soma first of all, without reluctance, made restitution of the Brahman's consort.
paragraphs.original: सोमो राजा प्रथमो ब्रह्मजायां पुनः प्रायच्छदहृणीयमानः ।
paragraphs.translit: somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyāṃ punaḥ prāyacchadahṛṇīyamānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Mitra and Varuna were the inviters: Agni as Hota; took her hand and led her.
paragraphs.original: अन्वर्तिता वरुणो मित्र आसीदग्निर्होता हस्तगृह्या निनाय
paragraphs.translit: anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīdagnirhotā hastagṛhyā nināya

paragraphs.text: 3. The man, her pledge, must by her hand be taken when they have cried, She is a Brahman's consort.
She stayed not for a herald to conduct her: thus is the kingdom of a ruler guarded.
paragraphs.original: न दूताय प्रह्ये तस्थ एषा तथा राष्ट्रं गुपितं क्षत्रियस्य
paragraphs.translit: na dūtāya prahye tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya

paragraphs.text: 4. Thus spake of her those Gods of old, Seven Rsis who sate them down to their austere devotion:
paragraphs.original: देवा एतस्यामवदन्त पूर्वे सप्तऋषयस्तपसे ये निषेदुः ।
paragraphs.translit: devā etasyāmavadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayastapase ye niṣeduḥ |

paragraphs.text: Dire is a Brahman's wife led home by others: in the supremest heaven she plants confusion.
paragraphs.original: भीमा जाया ब्राह्मणस्योपनीता दुर्धां दधाति परमे व्योमन्
paragraphs.translit: bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyopanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti parame vyoman

paragraphs.text: 5. The Brahmacari goes engaged in duty: he is a member of the Gods' own body.
paragraphs.original: ब्रह्मचारी चरति वेविषद्विषः स देवानां भवत्येकमङ्गम् ।
paragraphs.translit: brahmacārī carati veviṣadviṣaḥ sa devānāṃ bhavatyekamaṅgam |

paragraphs.text: Through him Brhaspati obtained his consort, as the Gods gained the ladle brought by Soma.
paragraphs.original: तेन जायामन्वविन्दद्बृहस्पतिः सोमेन नीतां जुह्वं न देवाः
paragraphs.translit: tena jāyāmanvavindadbṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ na devāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. So then the Gods restored her, so men gave the woman back again.
The Kings who kept their promises restored the Brahman's wedded wife,
7. Having restored the Brahman's wife, and freed them, with Gods' aid, from sin,
They shared the fulness of the earth, and won themselves extended sway.
